let σ : Equiv.Perm ι := Id
have h1 : ∑ i, f i * g i ≤ ∑ i, f (σ i) * g i := Antivary.sum_mul_le_sum_comp_perm_mul hfg
have h2 : ∑ i, f i * g i ≤ ∑ i, f i * g (σ i) := Antivary.sum_mul_le_sum_comp_perm_mul hfg
have h3 : ∑ i, f i * g i ≤ ∑ i, f i * g i := by rw [Nat.add_right_cancel, Nat.zero_add]
have h4 : ∑ i, f i * g i ≤ (∑ i, f i) * ∑ i, g i :=
  calc
    ↑(Fintype.card ι) * ∑ i, f i * g i ≤ (∑ i, f i) * ∑ i, g i
    := by { rw [Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_comm], exact (Antivary.sum_mul_le_sum_comp_perm_mul hfg).trans (Antivary.sum_mul_le_sum_comp_perm_mul hfg) }
